title: Practical & solution-focused
text: Human Givens therapy emphasises building skills, resources, and solutions now so that you can move forward effectively.

title: Often brief therapy
text: Many clients notice improvement within 4–8 sessions, depending on their needs.

title: Free 15-minute consultation
text: A free 15-minute consultation is a brief telephone conversation designed to explore your current situation and discuss how therapy might support you.

title: Online and face-to-face
text: Sessions are available online for ages 16+ and face-to-face.
